synthesis.body: "Which suites actually run" written into docs/specs/<feature>/notes/ is accurate on the day it ships and never again — shipped specs are frozen, so the next test directory is unrun by default with nothing saying so. Encode it instead as a lint case: enumerate the destination directories, require each to be named by a runner call site or listed in an in-source exemption set with a one-line reason, and fail on a stale exemption whose directory is gone.

title: Coverage recorded only in a spec note freezes when the spec ships
